claims.text: A knight in battered plate armour rides a huge black dragon low over a burning battlefield.
Smoke and embers stream beneath the dragon, with firelight catching the knight's battered plate armour.
The dragon banks over a collapsing fire trench as the battlefield opens below.

subjects.description: A knight in battered plate armour, soot-streaked and firelit.
A huge black dragon with wide wings and a hide glossy with soot and firelight.
A burning battlefield with collapsing fire trenches, churning smoke, and drifting embers.

speakers.description: The knight in battered plate armour.

summary.text: A knight in battered plate armour rides a huge black dragon low over a burning battlefield in a live-action cinematic sequence.
